You will collaborate with peers on integration and downstream testing to help ensure no defects reach production. As a subject-matter expert in Claims, test automation, test data creation automation, and enterprise test strategy, you will work with the broader team to help ensure all strategic and operational projects meet quality standards by following recognized QA methodologies and best practices.
cond_0045.responsibilities:
Coordinate with development and QA team to support the overall roadmap of automation solutions.
Develop reusable automation components for [Product name masked] based and other applications.
Mentor automation engineers on the team to help optimize automation outcomes.
Develop utilities to support test data automation.
Perform feasibility analysis and work with the team to identify potential test automation opportunities.
Collaborate on building the testing process and policies, and help define technical solutions and tools to support the testing framework.
Support cross-functional team collaboration, analytical prioritization, and internal testing audits to help ensure product quality.
Help ensure automation coverage for in-sprint and regression tests in the claims program.
Work with the team to optimize testing techniques and uphold quality standards in line with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Review functional specifications and assist in evaluating test automation approaches.
Generate quality metrics in partnership with Release Management to provide accurate information on team performance.
Additional duties as assigned or necessary.
cond_0045.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or a related field.
5+ Years of relevant experience in in-sprint and regression test automation.
5+ Years of relevant experience in claims end-to-end lifecycle from a QA standpoint, covering claims pre-processing, adjudication, and post-adjudication.
5+ Years of hands-on experience with Selenium, Jenkins, and CT enablement.
5+ Years of hands-on experience in claims system testing for claims process testing.
5+ Years of Agile methodologies experience.
1+ Year of experience in structured testing methodology, with a proven ability to break down requirements into high-level and detailed test cases.
1+ Year of experience with Scorecards, Dashboards, Statements of Work (SOWs), SLAs, Operational Level Agreements (OLAs), and performance management metrics.
Experience with written and verbal communication that is clear, concise, grammatically correct, and professional.
Experience with Test Automation tools.
Preferred Requirements
5+ Years of relevant experience in test data automation with other health plans.
Automation Tool certifications.
Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD related to test automation solutions.
Prior people leadership experience.
Prior experience in the healthcare and/or insurance industry.
Working experience in Extract Transform Load (ETL) and cloud environments.
Experience in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including the creation of process flow diagrams and/or technical process flows.

You will collaborate with peers on integration and downstream testing to help ensure no defects reach production. As a subject-matter expert in Claims, test automation, test data creation automation, and enterprise test strategy, you will work with the broader team to help ensure all strategic and operational projects meet quality standards by following recognized QA methodologies and best practices.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Coordinate with development and QA team to support the overall roadmap of automation solutions.
Develop reusable automation components for [Product name masked] based and other applications.
Mentor automation engineers on the team to help optimize automation outcomes.
Develop utilities to support test data automation.
Perform feasibility analysis and work with the team to identify potential test automation opportunities.
Collaborate on building the testing process and policies, and help define technical solutions and tools to support the testing framework.
Support cross-functional team collaboration, analytical prioritization, and internal testing audits to help ensure product quality.
Help ensure automation coverage for in-sprint and regression tests in the claims program.
Work with the team to optimize testing techniques and uphold quality standards in line with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Review functional specifications and assist in evaluating test automation approaches.
Generate quality metrics in partnership with Release Management to provide accurate information on team performance.
Additional duties as assigned or necessary.
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or a related field.
5+ Years of relevant experience in in-sprint and regression test automation.
5+ Years of relevant experience in claims end-to-end lifecycle from a QA standpoint, covering claims pre-processing, adjudication, and post-adjudication.
5+ Years of hands-on experience with Selenium, Jenkins, and CT enablement.
5+ Years of hands-on experience in claims system testing for claims process testing.
5+ Years of Agile methodologies experience.
1+ Year of experience in structured testing methodology, with a proven ability to break down requirements into high-level and detailed test cases.
1+ Year of experience with Scorecards, Dashboards, Statements of Work (SOWs), SLAs, Operational Level Agreements (OLAs), and performance management metrics.
Experience with written and verbal communication that is clear, concise, grammatically correct, and professional.
Experience with Test Automation tools.
Preferred Requirements
5+ Years of relevant experience in test data automation with other health plans.
Automation Tool certifications.
Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD related to test automation solutions.
Prior people leadership experience.
Prior experience in the healthcare and/or insurance industry.
Working experience in Extract Transform Load (ETL) and cloud environments.
Experience in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including the creation of process flow diagrams and/or technical process flows.

cond_0297.intro: We are looking for a Sr QA Analyst, Claims to join our team. In this role, you will work alongside the QA team to support overall quality assurance and coordinate in-sprint automation using Java and Selenium. You will collaborate with peers on integration and downstream testing to help ensure no defects reach production. As a subject-matter expert in Claims, test automation, test data creation automation, and enterprise test strategy, you will work with the broader team to help ensure all strategic and operational projects meet quality standards by following recognized QA methodologies and best practices.
cond_0297.responsibilities:
Coordinate with development and QA team to support the overall roadmap of automation solutions.
Develop reusable automation components for [Product name masked] based and other applications.
Mentor automation engineers on the team to help optimize automation outcomes.
Develop utilities to support test data automation.
Perform feasibility analysis and work with the team to identify potential test automation opportunities.
Collaborate on building the testing process and policies, and help define technical solutions and tools to support the testing framework.
Support cross-functional team collaboration, analytical prioritization, and internal testing audits to help ensure product quality.
Help ensure automation coverage for in-sprint and regression tests in the claims program.
Work with the team to optimize testing techniques and uphold quality standards in line with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Review functional specifications and assist in evaluating test automation approaches.
Generate quality metrics in partnership with Release Management to provide accurate information on team performance.
Additional duties as assigned or necessary.
cond_0297.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or a related field.
5+ Years of relevant experience in in-sprint and regression test automation.
5+ Years of relevant experience in claims end-to-end lifecycle from a QA standpoint, covering claims pre-processing, adjudication, and post-adjudication.
5+ Years of hands-on experience with Selenium, Jenkins, and CT enablement.
5+ Years of hands-on experience in claims system testing for claims process testing.
5+ Years of Agile methodologies experience.
1+ Year of experience in structured testing methodology, with a proven ability to break down requirements into high-level and detailed test cases.
1+ Year of experience with Scorecards, Dashboards, Statements of Work (SOWs), SLAs, Operational Level Agreements (OLAs), and performance management metrics.
Experience with written and verbal communication that is clear, concise, grammatically correct, and professional.
Experience with Test Automation tools.
Preferred Requirements
5+ Years of relevant experience in test data automation with other health plans.
Automation Tool certifications.
Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD related to test automation solutions.
Prior people leadership experience.
Prior experience in the healthcare and/or insurance industry.
Working experience in Extract Transform Load (ETL) and cloud environments.
Experience in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including the creation of process flow diagrams and/or technical process flows.
